Pilot Sample Size for Sequential AIPE: Contrast

Source: R/seq_aipe_c.R
seq_aipe_c_pilot.Rd

Returns the number of observations to collect from each group before the sequential accuracy in parameter estimation (AIPE) stopping rule for a contrast of group means, \(\psi = \sum_{k=1}^{K} c_k \mu_k\), can be evaluated for the first time with seq_aipe_c.

Usage

seq_aipe_c_pilot(width, conf_level = 0.95, m_0 = 4)

Arguments

width

The target full width of the confidence interval for the contrast (\(\omega\) in the cited article): the upper limit minus the lower limit, in the units of the outcome. A single positive number.

conf_level

The confidence level of the interval, a single number strictly between 0 and 1. Default 0.95.

m_0

The smallest pilot size allowed per group, a whole number of at least 4. Default 4.

Value

A single integer: the pilot sample size per group.

Details

The pilot size is $$m = \max\{m_0, \lceil 2 z_{\alpha/2} / \omega \rceil\},$$ where \(\omega\) is width, \(z_{\alpha/2}\) is the upper \(\alpha/2\) quantile of the standard normal distribution with \(\alpha\) equal to one minus conf_level, and \(m_0\) is m_0 (Kelley, Darku, and Chattopadhyay, 2018, Equation 21). Whatever the data, the stopping rule cannot be met with fewer than \(\lceil 2 z_{\alpha/2} / \omega \rceil\) observations per group, which is why the pilot is at least that large. Because a contrast is not scale free, the pilot size depends on the units of width: see seq_aipe_c.

References

Kelley, K., Darku, F. B., & Chattopadhyay, B. (2018). Accuracy in parameter estimation for a general class of effect sizes: A sequential approach. Psychological Methods, 23(2), 226–243. doi:10.1037/met0000127

See also

seq_aipe_c

Other seq_aipe_c: seq_aipe_c(), seq_aipe_sensitivity

Author

Ken Kelley kkelley@nd.edu, Francis Bilson Darku fbilsond@nd.edu, Bhargab Chattopadhyay bhargab@iiitvadodara.ac.in

Examples

# A 95% interval for a contrast no wider than 0.40 outcome units
seq_aipe_c_pilot(width = 0.40)
#> [1] 10

# The same target with at least 20 per group in the pilot
seq_aipe_c_pilot(width = 0.40, m_0 = 20)
#> [1] 20
